_comment: Copy this to mods.json and put your own account in it. mods.json is gitignored:
it is per-deployment configuration, not something to publish.
rights: 0 = ordinary player, 2 = game mod. Anything >= 2 is read as 2.
powers: omit the array entirely to grant every power the rank implies.
This file wins over the player save on login, so an owner who has been
demoted in-game can always take rights back by editing it.
Usernames are matched lowercased and trimmed.
